body.name: Armwise off-target refinement
body.construction: For each reduced atom \(r=((x_z(r))_z,y_{\mathcal T}(r))\) drawn with mass \(q_r\), refine independently over \(z\). If \(x_z(r)=t\in\mathcal T\), set \(X_z=t\), retain \(Y_t=y_t(r)\), and set the unused coordinates \(R_{c,z}\) to zero. If \(x_z(r)=\star\), draw \((C_z,V_z)\sim\eta_z\), set \(X_z=C_z\), set \(R_{C_z,z}=V_z\), and set the other unused \(R_{c,z}\) to zero. Mixing these full atoms defines \(\mathfrak R_p(q)\); when \(s_z(\star)=0\), use any fixed boundary allocation because the corresponding branch has zero mass. Observed outcomes are assigned only by the target rule \(Y=Y_t\) on \(\{X=t\}\) and the arm-specific rule \(Y=R_{c,z}\) on \(\{X=c,Z=z\}\).
